skills-frq-verbs.alt: A staircase of six task verbs, each asking for more than the one above. Identify: name it, a word or a phrase is enough. Define: give its meaning in a full sentence. Describe: give its features, what, where and how much. Explain: say why or how, with because or so. Compare: say how two things differ or match, speaking of both sides. Explain the degree: state the degree first, then explain why.
